title: I created the most comprehensive AI trading resource on the internet
author: NextgenAITrading
selftext:
For anyone experimenting with AI for trading, this library covers the process from researching a company to building a strategy, backtesting it, paper trading, and deploying to a brokerage.

Some of what’s inside:

* **Trading with ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.** Walkthroughs for connecting these tools, researching stocks, defining trading rules, and testing strategies.
* **Worked strategy experiments.** Dividend portfolios, momentum, Bitcoin trend following, options spreads, and leveraged ETFs, with rules, benchmark comparisons, drawdowns, fees, and trade diagnostics.
* **Walk-forward testing and overfitting.** Examples of selecting parameters, freezing the rules, and testing them on later dates.
* **AI model evaluations.** Comparisons on stock screening, options strategy development, planning, and execution, with exact model versions and grading methods.
* **Stock research and developer resources.** Fundamentals, ownership disclosures, trading calculators, and Python/TypeScript SDK examples.

The detailed experiments are especially worth reading. One options study follows six strategy variants through 94 audited fills, then examines why a fixed premium budget produced no trades in the holdout period. Another follows a promising NVDA intraday strategy through a longer test where its initial advantage disappeared.

You can inspect the rules, assumptions, trades, and results, and use those details to plan your own tests.

[Browse the resource](https://nexustrade.io/explore)
